# Goal
Tabi held round22/attempt1; C1 depth lowest tie8: 0->12 semantically checked lifecycle rows over the retained round21 acquisition. Scalar8 unchanged. No new browser run or branch coverage credit. The old structural measure admits all-silent synthetic cases; new explicit finite outcome oracle must distinguish actual case semantics. Correct historical W1 wake-history and W2 chronology debt without rewriting history or claiming authenticated settlement. Baseline 5f585773258b33d2d514b00cd0b0775333578db6. L1 holds canonical planner; advisors are not judges.
# Contract
Lane root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin; all paths absolute. Every Report: trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/tabi-shokunin/<that path>. Read-only seats write ONLY their assigned report; no production edits. Code writers use ONLY their named private clone, never shared lane production files, Git index/jj state, fleet, siblings or other clones. Never run builds/tests/linters/formatters/smokes; L1 executes once after integration. Never spawn/delegate/background jobs. Never message dead/failed/parked historical seats or broadcast; report unresolved issues, do not revive anyone. No browser, network probes, services, REA, credentials, real-site actions. Source reopening may read retained actual own-work S101. No installs needed; if a needed install arises read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first and record tool/version/channel/reason. All pacman transactions PAUSED: never pacman -S/-Sy/-Syu/-U/-R/downgrade or service restart. Only authorized uv/npx/official binaries. No mutations outside lane.
API: BuildOracle owns .ufo/waves/round-22/measure-c1.mjs and corpus/evidence/round-22/semantic-expectations.json. Export evaluate(files) and INPUT_PATHS; evaluate returns JSON {schema,metric:'c1_semantically_checked_lifecycle_rows',value,c1_semantically_checked_lifecycle_rows,verdict,exit,findings,rows}. CLI node measure-c1.mjs FULL40HEXREV reads exact Git blobs shell-free with isolated Git env/no replace objects; missing new expectations and note means baseline0, partial missing means failed0. Values12 only after explicit actual semantics: pending finite; Completed click/requestSubmit/native/delayed/auto-positive; Canceled reset/remove; Error reject/throw/invalid-submit/auto-invalid. Match exact current invocation, sequence and finite windows, raw-summary and fixture/producer/acquisition hashes, canonical note source first line S101, no new producer claim. New note path corpus/knowledge/webmcp-lifecycle-oracle-round-22.md. Independent fixed expectations must not be recomputed from the evaluated receipt. Export stable findings semantic_status/semantic_output/semantic_error/semantic_timing/semantic_navigation/semantic_delayed/evidence_binding/case_set/source_binding/input_shape/revision_input. Exit0 baseline/clean,1 failed,2 could-not-evaluate. No import of old counter as outcome oracle; it remains frozen and unchanged. Tests mutate coherent summaries/raw and update digest links so red outcomes test semantics, not incidental stale hashes.
Each code writer may git add/commit ONLY assigned files inside its PRIVATE clone using fixture identity, return full commit plus path/digest list; never touch lane VCS. No tests. Parent imports fixed blobs.
